summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a note purchase agreement with an institutional investor for a $300,000 convertible note and warrant. The note converts at the lower of $0.266 or 90% of the lowest VWAP over 20 days (floor $0.05), with 8% interest (14% on default). The warrant allows purchase of 1,127,820 shares at CAD$0.36 for five years. Proceeds of $270,000 are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine financing, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, or control change. The variable pricing and resale registration are typical for small-cap financings.
